verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a remote desktop product with address books, settings, audit logs and session recordings. The pack shows no documented export of user data in open formats. Self-hosting, AGPL licensing, and a community 'no vendor lock in' remark are adjacent openness traits, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
